title: Teach ScanFinder a new document
description: Teach-first: with one example invoice already imported, open Teach, pick it, choose the type, draw a box around the issuer, the date and the invoice number, confirm the read-backs, and commit. Explains why teaching one document pays off for every future one from that sender.

steps.narration: Before you import a pile of documents from a new supplier, it pays to teach ScanFinder one of them first. A minute of pointing at where the details sit means every future document from that sender is read and filed automatically.
steps.caption: Teach one document — file every one after it

steps.narration: Open Teach from the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Click Teach

wait_for.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: The wizard walks you through it: pick a document, draw a box around each detail, done. Nothing is saved until the very end, so you can go back at any point.
steps.caption: Pick → draw → done · nothing saved until the end

target.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: Continue.
steps.caption: 2. Continue

wait_for.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

target.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: It lists the documents waiting to be checked. We imported one Copperfield Electrical invoice earlier — a clean, typical example is exactly what you want. Click it.
steps.caption: 3. Pick a clean, typical example

target.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: Continue.
steps.caption: 4. Continue

wait_for.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

target.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: Tell it what kind of document this is. The type decides which details it looks for and where the file ends up, so it matters. This one's an invoice.
steps.caption: 5. Choose the document type

target.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: Continue.
steps.caption: 6. Continue

steps.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

wait_for.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: The page opens zoomed to fit the width. Drag with the right mouse button to move around it, and use plus and minus to zoom. We'll work from the top of the page.
steps.caption: Right-drag to pan · + / − to zoom

steps.narration: Now the details, one at a time. First: who sent it. Drag a box around the company name wherever it's printed — the letterhead is fine.
steps.caption: Field 1 — who sent it: draw a box on the name

from.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

to.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.caption: 7. Drag a box around the company name

wait_for.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: ScanFinder reads the box back to you. Check it says exactly what's printed — if not, redraw it or type the name.
steps.caption: Check the read-back matches the page

target.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: Looks right — next.
steps.caption: 8. Looks right

steps.narration: Now the invoice date. Draw the box around the value itself, not the label. ScanFinder spots the label on its own and uses it to find the date on future documents, even when the layout shifts a little.
steps.caption: Field 2 — the date: box the VALUE, not the label

from.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

to.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.caption: 9. Drag a box around the date

wait_for.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: It read the date, and it found the Invoice Date label just to the left — that's what it will look for next time.
steps.caption: Value + the label it found

target.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: Looks right.
steps.caption: 10. Looks right

steps.narration: Last one: the invoice number — the reference that ends up in the file name.
steps.caption: Field 3 — the invoice number

from.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

to.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.caption: 11. Drag a box around the number

wait_for.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: Same check.
steps.caption: Check the read-back

target.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: Looks right.
steps.caption: 12. Looks right

target.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: All three done. Click Review to see everything it found.
steps.caption: 13. Review

wait_for.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: Here's everything it learned from this document. If anything's wrong, go back and redraw it.
steps.caption: Everything it learned — check it

target.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: Otherwise continue — this files the document and saves what it learned.
steps.caption: 14. Continue to save

wait_for.window: Teach a new document — Scan Finder

steps.narration: That's it. ScanFinder now knows where to look on Copperfield invoices. The next few may still pass through Review so you can confirm them — each confirmation makes it more certain, and soon they'll file themselves.
steps.caption: Done — the next few get a quick confirm, then hands-off

steps.narration: Do this once for each of your regular suppliers. Next: importing a whole folder.
steps.caption: Next: import a folder of scans
